description: This file implements a SQL-based job store for Mattermost, including methods for saving, updating, retrieving, deleting, and cleaning up job records in a database.

classes.name: SqlJobStore
classes.description: A struct that manages job records in a SQL database, providing methods for CRUD operations and cleanup.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a job record to the database, marshaling job data to JSON.

methods.name: SaveOnce
methods.description: Inserts a job record into the database if no pending or in-progress jobs of the same type exist, using a transaction.

methods.name: UpdateOptimistically
methods.description: Updates a job's status and data in the database if the current status matches, returning success status.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a job identified by ID.

methods.name: UpdateStatusOptimistically
methods.description: Atomically updates job status with optimistic concurrency, returning the updated job.

methods.name: GetAllByTypesPage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of jobs filtered by multiple types.

methods.name: GetAllByType
methods.description: Retrieves all jobs of a specific type.

methods.name: GetAllByTypeAndStatus
methods.description: Retrieves all jobs of a specific type and status.

methods.name: GetAllByTypePage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of jobs filtered by type.

methods.name: GetAllByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves all jobs with a specific status.

methods.name: GetAllByTypesAndStatusesPage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of jobs filtered by multiple types and statuses.

methods.name: GetNewestJobByStatusAndType
methods.description: Retrieves the newest job matching a status and type.

methods.name: GetNewestJobByStatusesAndType
methods.description: Retrieves the newest job matching multiple statuses and a type.

methods.name: GetCountByStatusAndType
methods.description: Counts jobs matching a status and type.

methods.name: GetByTypeAndData
methods.description: Retrieves jobs by type and specific JSON data filters, optionally using master database.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Deletes old jobs based on expiry time and batch size, with retries for certain errors.
